H4609: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3254: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
H2671: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear
H8150: to point (transitive or intransitive); intensively, to pierce; figuratively, to inculcate
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H7574: the Spanish broom (from its pole-like stems)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1481: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
H4902: Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him
H7931: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H6938: Kedar, a son of Ishmael; also (collectively) Bedouin (as his descendants or representatives)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
